failure_or_lesson: A neat synthetic demo is not evidence of advantage unless the general-model baseline gets the same authorized history and comparable budget, and the same-evidence ablation isolates judgment updating from retrieval quality.
goal: Prevent a future personal-judgment comparison from changing histories, budgets, ablation evidence, or transfer hosts after the test.
notes: No actual cohort, threshold, model, comparator output, blind rating, or behavioral result has been fabricated.
procedure: Freeze a dated manifest after pilot with case history and sealed-rubric hashes, baseline design, thresholds, and builder recipe. Validate every attempt against it, require complete before/after paired arms, reject unfair evidence or budget changes, and leave scoring to separately collected blinded results.
validation: Nine local component tests passed, including unfair budget/evidence, incomplete matrix, and transfer-host isolation checks; CI pending.
